blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The NU Pep Squad emerged victorious anew on Saturday night as it successfully defended its crown in the UAAP Season 89 Cheerdance Competition at Mall of Asia Arena. NU also clinched its second three-peat in school history, mirroring the squad’s achievement from 2012-2015. NU Pep Squad claimed a record-extending 10th title.
